Dehydrated Fenugreek Seeds Supplier — Dehydrated Fenugreek Seeds for B2B Food Manufacturing

Tradenest Naturals is a reliable dehydrated fenugreek seeds supplier from India. We provide clean, food-grade dehydrated methi dana for food manufacturers, spice blenders, exporters, wholesalers, and private label brands. Our fenugreek seeds support seasoning, bakery, ready-to-cook, nutraceutical, and traditional food applications. Buyers can request whole seeds, cracked seeds, or finely milled fenugreek seeds powder based on their recipe and processing needs. Fenugreek seeds have a distinctive bitter, warm, and aromatic profile. They also provide useful texture and flavor in spice blends. Therefore, they remain a popular ingredient across Indian, Middle Eastern, African, and global food markets. Tradenest Naturals supplies consistent lots with practical packaging, traceability, and export support.

Product Overview

Dehydrated fenugreek seeds are dried seeds of the fenugreek plant, also known as Trigonella foenum-graecum. The product contains no intentionally added preservatives, colors, or artificial flavors unless a customer requests a specific formulation. We select mature seeds and process them under controlled conditions. Our standard supply focuses on clean, dry, and aromatic methi dana. The product may be supplied as whole seeds for further processing. In addition, we can provide customized grinding and sieving. A common fine specification is fenugreek seeds 80 mesh, subject to final approval and product testing.

Processing Method

First, we source fenugreek seeds through established agricultural and ingredient networks. Next, we inspect the incoming material for visible quality, cleanliness, and suitability. We then clean the seeds to remove foreign matter and unwanted particles. After cleaning, we use controlled dehydration or drying practices to reduce moisture. This step supports storage stability and helps preserve the natural aroma. We then grade, pulverize when required, and sieve the material to achieve the agreed particle size. Finally, we pack each approved batch in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging.
  • Raw material selection and receiving inspection
  • Cleaning and foreign-matter removal
  • Controlled drying and moisture management
  • Grinding and sieving for powder specifications
  • Batch identification and packing inspection
Processing parameters can vary by seed condition, order size, and final application. We confirm the agreed specification before production. This approach helps buyers receive a practical and repeatable ingredient.

Typical Technical Specifications

Our typical whole-seed specification includes low moisture, clean appearance, and natural fenugreek aroma. For powder orders, we commonly offer 60 to 80 mesh. We can also review finer or coarser particle sizes for suitable applications.
  • Form: Whole seeds, cracked seeds, or powder
  • Mesh: Typically 60–80 mesh for powder; 80 mesh available on request
  • Moisture: Typically not more than 8%
  • Purity: Typically 99% minimum, subject to agreed specification
  • Color: Natural yellow to yellow-brown
  • Flavor: Warm, bitter, earthy, and slightly maple-like
These values represent typical commercial targets, not a substitute for a buyer-approved specification. Final values depend on the product form, crop, processing method, and destination requirements. We can discuss laboratory testing and documentation during quotation.

Quality and Food Safety Approach

Tradenest Naturals follows documented food safety practices, standard operating procedures, moisture control, batch traceability, and quality inspection. We review customer requirements before production. In addition, we can provide available batch documents and product information according to the order and destination market. Certifications and quality standards depend on the manufacturing site, product category, destination, and contract requirements. We do not claim certifications without confirmation. Buyers should specify required standards, such as a food safety system, allergen statement, microbial limits, pesticide requirements, or import documentation. Our team then confirms what documents and testing can support the shipment. Quality checks may include appearance, odor, moisture, foreign matter, particle size, and other agreed parameters. For export orders, we also review packaging, labeling, and documentation needs. Therefore, buyers receive a clearer supply plan before dispatch.

Applications

Dehydrated fenugreek seeds offer strong value in both whole-seed and powder formats. The ingredient works well in dry blends and products that need a warm, characteristic spice note.
  • Curries, gravies, pickles, and traditional spice preparations
  • Curry powder, garam masala, chat masala, and seasoning blends
  • Bakery products, savory snacks, crackers, and namkeen
  • Ready-to-cook meals, instant mixes, and soup formulations
  • Chutney powders, herbal blends, and specialty food products
  • Nutraceutical and health-food formulations, subject to regulatory review
Whole seeds suit tempering, roasting, extraction, and further grinding. Meanwhile, powder offers faster blending and more even distribution. Our technical team can help match particle size with the buyer’s process.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We use food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging designed for storage and transportation. Standard options include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. Bulk bags and customized export packaging are also available for larger programs. Packaging can include inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, or private label formats. Each pack can carry product name, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage guidance, and required regulatory information. Export labels follow the approved customer artwork and destination requirements. Typical shelf life is up to 12 months from manufacture when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. A longer or different shelf-life declaration requires review against the final packaging and quality specification. Store the product in a cool, dry, clean area. Protect it from direct sunlight, excess humidity, heat, and strong odors.

MOQ, Samples, and Lead Time

The minimum order quantity for a dehydrated fenugreek seeds supplier depends on product form, packaging, customization, and stock availability. Our standard commercial MOQ commonly starts at 100 kg. However, smaller trial quantities may be considered for samples or selected stock items. Private label and custom packaging orders usually require a higher MOQ. Lead time depends on raw material availability, quantity, testing, packaging, and destination documentation. Standard orders may require approximately 2 to 4 weeks after specification and payment confirmation. Custom formulations or printed packaging may require additional time. We confirm the production schedule in the quotation. To request a sample or quote, send the required form, mesh size, quantity, packaging format, destination country, and target application. Also share any quality, labeling, certification, or testing requirements. Our team will review the request and provide the most suitable commercial offer.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

  • Reliable supply from an India-based food ingredient partner
  • Flexible whole-seed and powder specifications
  • Support for bulk, wholesale, OEM, and private label programs
  • Moisture-resistant packaging for domestic and export shipments
  • Clear communication on MOQ, documentation, and lead time
  • Practical support for formulation and application requirements
Tradenest Naturals serves buyers seeking a dependable dehydrated fenugreek seeds exporter and bulk methi dana supplier. We support wholesalers, importers, food brands, and manufacturers with scalable supply. Above all, we focus on consistent specifications, transparent service, and long-term business partnerships.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

The usual MOQ starts at 100 kg for standard supply. We confirm the final MOQ after reviewing form, packaging, and customization.

What specifications are available?

Typical specifications include 60–80 mesh powder, up to 8% moisture, and 99% minimum purity. Final specifications require buyer approval.

What certifications apply?

Applicable certifications and documents depend on the product, facility, and destination. We confirm available documentation instead of making unsupported certification claims.

What packaging and shelf life are offered?

We offer food-grade packs from 1 kg to bulk bags. Typical shelf life reaches 12 months under recommended storage conditions.

How can I request a sample or quotation?

Send your quantity, destination, product form, mesh, packaging, and quality requirements. We will then review the request and respond with supply details.

Standards & references

  • APEDA — India’s agri & processed food export authority
  • FSSAI — Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
